definitions.scores: Out-of-sample predictive R2; negative scores retained. Undefined evidence fails criteria.
definitions.utility: P1->U and P2->V MLP task-probe R2 must each meet 0.99; an average cannot rescue a failed purpose.
definitions.protection: Every prohibited pair meets its threshold for both independently fitted linear and MLP attackers.
definitions.selected: Aliases read saved validation selections. A failed-utility-floor fallback is labeled diagnostic only.
definitions.pairing: Left minus right within each seed, then mean and sample SD of paired differences. All declared pairs are retained, even if ineligible.
definitions.sample_sd: ddof=1; undefined for fewer than two observed seeds. Complete/count fields expose undefined values.
definitions.direct_prediction: Native released predictions for oracle/prediction-only controls; independent task-probe utility is a separate metric.
definitions.scope: Finite-budget empirical evaluations, not a universal privacy guarantee. Oracle and prediction-only controls can differ in representation dimension and access to latent labels.
